title: Programmable retention policies and legal-hold exemption audit API
creator: Asha Menon
description: Deliver a programmable retention policy system and a companion audit API that together enable tenants to define fine-grained retention rules, observe policy evaluation telemetry, and obtain verifiable evidence when records are exempted because of legal holds. The feature surface includes: a small policy DSL for time-to-live / soft-delete / hard-delete semantics, policy precedence (global -> tenant -> dataset -> record-tag), a legal-hold exemption mechanism with immutability markers, a retention simulator for dry-runs, and an evidence bundle API that returns signed proofs (hashes + timestamps) for purge/retain decisions. Non-goals: replacing customer-side data pipelines or providing long-term archival storage services. This ticket covers product requirements, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for Console + Control Plane APIs; implementation tasks will be split across runtime/infra and console teams.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI: customers can create and attach programmable retention policies to a tenant and to individual datasets with a preview of affected record counts (approximate) and estimated purge dates.
Policy DSL: supports TTL, keep-until-date, tag-based overrides, and a 'recall_window' parameter for soft-delete staging.
Legal hold: a tenant-level legal-hold flag prevents hard-delete; records under legal hold are marked immutable and are excluded from purge runs unless hold is cleared by an authorised identity.
Retention simulator: run a dry-run that simulates purges over a time range and emits a deterministic report with counts and sample record IDs without exposing PII in the preview mode.

Evidence API: /v1/compliance/evidence returns a time-stamped, cryptographically signed bundle (SHA-256 manifest + signature) describing the set of records evaluated, policy versions, hold state, and final decision (retain|soft-delete|hard-delete).
Audit trail: every policy change, legal-hold toggle, and purge execution is recorded in the audit log with user, timestamp, affected policy version, and exportable evidence bundle ID.
SLOs: policy evaluation telemetry added to Console for per-tenant policy evaluation latency and failure rates; infra fallbacks documented.
Security review: design and API pass security review and threat model checklist before GA.
tasks: Finalize Policy DSL grammar and precedence rules (PM + Eng + Legal).
Spec evidence bundle schema and signature mechanism (crypto team + Eng).
Implement retention simulator in control plane (backend).
Add policy management UI flows in Console (Product + Design + FE).
Runtime enforcement: integrate policy checks into purge pipeline with soft-delete staging and recall window support.
Legal-hold UI + RBAC controls: only authorised identities can set/clear holds; hold events generate immutable audit entries.
Expose /v1/compliance/evidence API and add pagination + filtering by evidence_id, tenant_id, date range.
E2E tests: simulation runs, hold toggles, evidence bundle verification, and cross-region residency acceptance tests.
Docs: customer-facing guide, API reference, and a step-by-step retention simulator walkthrough.
Create migration plan for existing tenant policies and a phased opt-in rollout (Beta -> GA).

2025-02-12 Diego Ruiz: Spike complete on policy DSL; initial grammar attached in Confluence. Need decision on whether 'recall_window' is expressed as days or ISO-8601 duration. Prefer ISO-8601 for future extensibility.
2025-02-14 Legal (Marta Kovacs): Legal-hold behavior approved; require immutable audit entries and exportable chain-of-custody report. Also requested role-based approvals for clearing holds.
2025-02-16 Eng (Rahul Patel): Prototype evidence API returns deterministic manifest + HMAC-SHA256 signature using control-plane signing key; crypto team to review for key rotation support.
2025-02-18 PM: Marking 'In Progress'. Next steps: security review kickoff and scheduling front-end mock review with Design.
evidence_bundle_format: manifest.json (SHA-256 hashes of record IDs + policy_version.txt + hold_state.json) zipped and signed; provides evidence_id used for lookup and verification
rollout_plan: Beta rollout to 10 pilot tenants in console-2025.03 with feature flag. Collect simulator telemetry and evidence API usage metrics for 4 weeks. GA contingent on security review and 0 high-severity regression findings.
notes: Privacy-preserving previews must not expose PII. Simulator should sample IDs with deterministic bucketing to allow reproducible dry-runs without full data export. Cross-region residency rules must supersede tenant-level TTLs when regulator requires local residence.
